display_title: I Became a Chef to Save a Different World
description:
“Please come with me and save the world.”

While enjoying a holiday, chef Yoo-jung’s peaceful life is suddenly interrupted by a mysterious man.

Introducing himself as an otherworldly being, ‘Nemo’ asks Yoo-jung to cross over to the world beyond the shoe cabinet and help him save it.

No matter how many times Yoo-jung refuses, this man… is unbelievably persistent. And to make things worse—has he really survived his whole life eating nothing but stones?

Feeling sorry for him, Yoo-jung prepares various dishes, feeding and taking care of him for days—until one day, Nemo suddenly disappears.

Before long, Yoo-jung steps through the passage to the other world.

Will Yoo-jung be able to find Nemo again?

(Source: Naver, translated)
